title: Dog_Bones
flavor_text: The neighbor dogs, Festus the Mastiff and his friend Klondike the Alaskan Husky, have been spending a lot of their time burying bones in the park. See if you can “dig up” the locations of all the bones in this grid, then feel around for something else that Betty the Maltese wishes Festus and Klondike would learn to do instead. Each number represents the number of bones that can be found adjacent to it. (including diagonally). No bones will be found in cells containing a number.

reasoning.explanation: Mark cells with numbers and identify adjacent empty cells to find cells that could contain bones.
Use logic to place bones in the grid by marking cells where adjacent counts match, resulting in a completed bone layout.
Translate the pattern of bone placements into braille by mapping bone patterns to braille dots, which reveals the answer 'NEW TRICKS'.
